quantity: limiting relative slenderness of the web
classification_rule: The section family is selected by comparison with the diagrams printed in Table 9; automatic geometry classification is not provided.

group_1_i_section.visual_description: I-shaped and related doubly symmetric built-up/proprietary sections shown in the first diagram row

group_2_box_section.visual_description: Closed/box-like sections shown in the second diagram row

group_3_channel_section.visual_description: Open channel-like sections shown in the third diagram row

group_4_tee_section.visual_description: T-shaped sections shown in the fourth diagram row
group_4_tee_section.boundary_rule: For lambda_bar below 0.8 or above 4, use 0.8 or 4 respectively.

notes: For a box section, evaluate the plate parallel to the plane in which overall member stability is checked.
The <= sign in the printed formulas denotes an upper cap on the calculated limit.
More slender webs require separately justified stability.
